notes: Some releases have a Dolby TrueHD Atmos track your box cannot actually play, and until now that made the whole movie fall back to the slower backup player - which is what caused the pixelation and lag on 4K. The player now switches to the compatibility audio track that ships alongside it and keeps using the fast player. It only ever changes the audio FORMAT, never the language: if there is no alternative in the same language it leaves everything alone. It also remembers, so the next movie picks the right track straight away with no delay.
